lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regularized 2D array of high-luminance circular local maxima arranged in vertical columns of 3-5 spots and horizontal rows spanning the length of the visible mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Nodes formed by the intersection of subtle vertical high-intensity bands and horizontal patterns of spots, creating a rectilinear grid morphology.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear feature on the dorsal-lateral interface characterized by a sharp step-gradient in pixel intensity.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of non-uniform high-luminance clusters within the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density cluster of approximately 15-20 elongated, high-luminance secondary silhouettes (remoras) localized in the ventral-pectoral region.
